About the record books +

One league history, from the early years to today. The record books bring together league records and season archives. Each season's details include source notes where available.

Team names are kept as they were that season, with familiar manager names alongside them. Final scores list the champion first. A dash means that detail hasn't been added yet. Score highlights cover the finals with scores in the record books.
